name: Dongjiang Environmental Company Limited
summary: Dongjiang Environmental Company Limited, together with its subsidiaries, provides environmental services in China and internationally. It operates through eight segments: Industrial Waste Resource Utilization; Industrial Waste Treatment and Disposal; Rare and Precious Metal Recycling; Municipal Waste Treatment and Disposal, Renewable Energy Utilization; Environmental Engineering and Services; Electronic Waste Dismantling; and Others. The company was formerly known as Shenzhen Dongjiang Environmental Company Limited and changed its name to Dongjiang Environmental Company Limited in December 2010.
